notes_zh:
- **新增** 快捷面板「图片」筛选支持瀑布流网格：在「设置 → 偏好 → 显示」开启后，图片以更大的瀑布流缩略图呈现，方便一眼挑图；支持方向键选择、回车 / 双击粘贴、Cmd+K 命令菜单，密度可调，拉宽面板自动增减列数（#72，感谢 @hiby-arch 的反馈）
- **新增** 图片 OCR 支持识别为 Markdown：自动识别段落、列表和表格并转为 Markdown 格式，需 macOS 26，旧系统自动回退为普通文本识别（#67，感谢 @bingoohuang 的贡献）
- **新增** 图片 OCR 设置独立成页，后台扫描支持随时停止
- **新增** 快捷面板中文件、以及内容为有效路径的纯文本，按 ⌘O 可直接在 Finder 中打开，预览区会显示 ⌘O 快捷键提示
- **优化** 大尺寸图片（如 PixPin 等截图工具复制的 TIFF）现在能完整保存与粘贴，不再因体积过大被丢弃；浏览、切换历史记录更流畅
- **优化** OCR 识别文本在快捷面板和详情页完整显示（原先超长会被截断），长文本渲染开销大幅降低
- **优化** 列表点选时的 CPU 占用
- **优化** 输入 `/` 唤起的分组 / 类型 / 应用子菜单：匹配项过多时收起为可滚动列表，不再撑高面板窗口
- **优化** 链接预览精简为「在浏览器中打开」（⌘O），移除冗余的复制按钮
- **优化** 含「运行快捷指令」的规则锁定为手动触发，避免误设为自动时静默不执行
- **优化** 图片类规则的触发通知不再显示 "[Image]" 占位文本，改为显示内容类型
- **修复** 在 macOS 26 上打开设置部分分页、或点击左侧菜单切换分页时崩溃（#70 #75，感谢 @Yricky、@DonKean 的反馈）
- **修复** 针对图片、视频等非文本内容的自动化规则现在能正常触发（例如「自动移入分组」），此前这类规则完全不执行（#71，感谢 @hiby-arch 的反馈）
- **修复** 在快捷面板手动应用「移入分组 / 置顶 / 标记敏感」类规则现在能正确生效
- **修复** 规则编辑器中「移入分组」动作显示异常（行高过高、标签丢失）
- **修复** 开启 AI Agent 集成后，App 在极少数情况下无提示自动退出
- **修复** 快捷面板输入 `/关键词` 时，若不匹配任何子菜单项，现在会按字面搜索内容；按 Esc 可退出子菜单、保留输入并直接搜索内容
- **修复** 设置窗口标题显示为原始键名的问题
- **修复** 主窗口侧边栏未延伸到标题栏顶部的问题
notes_en:
- **New** The quick panel's image filter can show a waterfall (masonry) grid: enable it in Settings → Preferences → Display to browse images as larger masonry thumbnails for quick visual picking. Supports arrow-key selection, Enter / double-click to paste, the Cmd+K command menu, adjustable density, and a column count that adapts as you widen the panel (#72, thanks @hiby-arch for the report)
- **New** Image OCR can recognize layout as Markdown: paragraphs, lists, and tables are converted automatically. Requires macOS 26; older systems fall back to plain-text recognition (#67, thanks @bingoohuang for the contribution)
- **New** Image OCR settings moved to a dedicated pane; the background scan can be stopped at any time
- **New** Press ⌘O on file clips — and plain-text clips whose content is a valid path — to reveal them in Finder; the preview shows the ⌘O hint
- **Improve** Large images (e.g. TIFF screenshots from tools like PixPin) are now saved and pasted at full resolution instead of being dropped when oversized; browsing and switching history feels smoother
- **Improve** Recognized OCR text is shown in full in the quick panel and detail view (previously truncated), with much lower rendering cost for long text
- **Improve** Reduced CPU usage when clicking through list items
- **Improve** The `/` group / type / app submenu caps matches into a scrollable list instead of stretching the panel
- **Improve** Link preview streamlined to "Open in browser" (⌘O); removed the redundant Copy button
- **Improve** Rules containing "Run Shortcut" are locked to manual triggering to avoid silently never running
- **Improve** Trigger notifications for image rules show the content type instead of the "[Image]" placeholder
- **Fix** Crash when opening certain Settings panes, or clicking the left sidebar to switch panes, on macOS 26 (#70 #75, thanks @Yricky and @DonKean for the reports)
- **Fix** Automation rules targeting non-text content (images, videos, etc.) now trigger correctly — e.g. "move to group" — they previously never ran (#71, thanks @hiby-arch for the report)
- **Fix** Manually applying "move to group / pin / mark sensitive" rules from the quick panel now works
- **Fix** Display glitch for the "move to group" action in the rule editor (row too tall, label missing)
- **Fix** App could quit unexpectedly with no prompt when AI Agent integration was enabled
- **Fix** Typing `/keyword` with no submenu match now searches content literally; press Esc to leave the submenu while keeping your query
- **Fix** Settings window title showing a raw localization key
- **Fix** Main window sidebar not extending to the top of the title bar

beta.notes_zh:
- **优化** 大幅降低浏览图片和历史记录时的内存占用：图片缓存改为按解码后的真实大小精确封顶（96MB），浏览结束后主动归还内存，不再随使用持续攀升
- **变更** 图片 OCR 改为默认关闭：它会在后台用 Vision 识别图片中的文字、内存开销较大；需要的用户可在「设置 → 图片 OCR」手动开启，开启处会提示可能增加内存占用
beta.notes_en:
- **Improve** Much lower memory usage when browsing images and history: the image cache is now capped by its actual decoded size (96MB) and memory is returned after browsing, so it no longer keeps climbing with use
- **Change** Image OCR is now off by default — it recognizes text in images in the background using Vision and is memory-heavy. Enable it in Settings → Image OCR if you need it; a memory note is shown there
